item.title: Hundreds evacuated from Oleshky as Melania Trump brokers rare Russia-Ukraine ceasefire
item.description: Hundreds of residents were evacuated from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky during a humanitarian ceasefire. The evacuation allowed individuals to leave amidst dire conditions of starvation and exhaustion. Three planes carrying evacuees successfully landed at an airport in Belarus as part of a coordinated operation. Both Russian and Ukrainian authorities confirmed the operation was conducted without any incidents.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Connecticut Volunteers Use Clams to Restore Eelgrass Meadows After 90% Decline
item.description: In a creative effort to restore the eelgrass meadows of Long Island Sound, volunteers in Connecticut have adopted an innovative technique. By attaching eelgrass seeds to clam shells, they facilitate the seeds' ability to embed into the seabed, leading to improved growth rates. Although early results show higher eelgrass coverage, there are ongoing concerns about long-term resilience. This initiative is a prime example of community-driven, nature-based environmental restoration strategies.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 1300 BC: Spain's copper mine linked to 11 Scandinavian bronze objects, hinting at ancient networks
item.description: Excavations at the Las Minillas site in Spain have unveiled substantial copper mining activities dating back to the Late Bronze Age. Investigations revealed a chemical link between the site and bronze artifacts discovered in Scandinavia. Researchers noted extensive mining operations and identified numerous nearby mining locations, indicating that southern Iberia was crucial for copper supply in Europe during this period.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: California barber taught himself stock trading and built $19 million fortune; now court revives family’s elder abuse claims against Morgan Stanley
item.description: Maurice Voce, a successful barber whose financial savvy amassed significant wealth, tragically deteriorated in health prior to his passing. Following his death, concerns arose about the effectiveness of his financial adviser's management amid Voce's cognitive difficulties. His family has since initiated a lawsuit against Morgan Stanley and adviser John Privitelli, alleging financial elder abuse.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Court revives Pennsylvania couple's six-year fight to add drive-through at truck stop
item.description: After almost six years of legal back-and-forth, a Pennsylvania convenience store finally received the go-ahead for a drive-through window. Jyotsna and Anil Jivani's 2020 proposal faced initial denial from township officials. However, in a significant ruling from the Pennsylvania Commonwealth Court in October 2026, judges overturned the lower court's verdict, affirming that the drive-through serves as a natural extension of their business, paving the way for construction approval.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Judge Blocks Farm Amphitheater: court backs conservation easement; landowner may appeal
item.description: A recent ruling by a Superior Court judge has put the brakes on the proposed outdoor amphitheater at Union Grove Farm, North Carolina. The Triangle Land Conservancy raised alarms over land-use regulations intended to safeguard agricultural landscapes. This dispute stems from a conservation easement put in place during the 1990s, underscoring the ongoing conflict between developmental ambitions and environmental protection in the area.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US organ donation group faces decertification after Kentucky man’s near-fatal ordeal
item.description: TJ Hoover II's case raised critical alarms when he showed signs of life just before organ retrieval, prompting intense scrutiny of patient safety protocols. Testimony from Donna Rhorer revealed disturbing insights about operational practices. Federal investigations uncovered multiple alarming incidents, leading to possible decertification for the Network for Hope, as the family demands accountability.

item.title: Atlanta Bilateral Meeting: Jaishankar meets Rubio on G20 FMM sidelines; focus on India–US cooperation
item.description: External affairs minister S Jaishankar had a productive meeting with US secretary of state Marco Rubio in Atlanta to explore avenues for enhanced bilateral ties. They shared reflections from their recent talks during the G20 foreign ministers' summit. Jaishankar's itinerary also included dialogues with both the US ambassador to India and India's ambassador to the US, highlighting active diplomatic channels.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: Florida installs 1,500 tons of recycled concrete to create three artificial reefs in Gulf waters
item.description: Workers are currently deploying three million pounds of recycled concrete drainage pipes to create artificial reefs on the seabed. This innovative project intends to boost marine habitats for local fish species, enhancing both fishing and diving experiences. Positioned between four and eight nautical miles off East Pass, the varied depths of the sites will facilitate diverse marine life.

item.title: UK Supreme Court rejects Rogano restaurant’s lost profit claim
item.description: Glasgow's renowned Rogano restaurant faced catastrophic circumstances after being ravaged by both flooding and fire, leading to its permanent closure. Forthwell Limited aimed to claim lost earnings for Lynnet Leisure, but the UK Supreme Court dismissed their case, stating that the legal exception they sought wasn't applicable in Scots law.

item.title: 20-year-old French student fights viral AI misinformation after fake image gets 1M likes
item.description: Théodore Cazals launched an initiative to challenge misleading AI-generated content after encountering a viral fake image. He created an account on X called 'Insane AI Slop', which quickly gained over 133,000 followers. Cazals noted recurring themes, such as poor children and religious content, in submissions he received. His efforts led to YouTube removing channels that posted questionable AI cartoons targeting children.
